blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tycoon Manuel V. Pangilinan is again raising the prospect of consolidation among the country’s four major telecommunications companies as they grapple with rising costs, sluggish revenue growth, and pressure on consumer spending. “We have four telcos serving a very small market,” Pangilinan said at PLDT Inc.’s third-quarter briefing on Thursday, noting that both businesses’ and consumers’ wallets are now under pressure. “This is untenable for each of us, right? We have to consolidate.” READ: PLDT banks on late rebound after flat H1 While the country’s major telco operators remain profitable, they reported lower net income in the first […]...
